translations.text: An overseer is to be faithful to the word of teaching, so that he may be able both to encourage with sound teaching and to rebuke those who oppose it.
They profess to know God, but deny him by their deeds. They are defiled and disobedient, unfit for any good work.
Not pilfering, but showing complete faithfulness with goodness, so that in everything they may adorn the teaching of God our Savior.
And let us await the blessed hope and the appearance of the glory of the great God and our Savior Jesus Christ.
Who gave himself for us, so that he might redeem us from all lawlessness and purify for himself a people of his own, zealous for good works.
